title: Task Sync
text: Run code of downstream function-call subsystem or Stateflow chart by spawning an example RTOS ( VxWorks ) task, 1 input, {Timer size} sets Number of bits to store clock tick; {Task name (10 characters or less)} sets the task function name, {Simulink task priority (0–255)} sets the rTOS task priority, {Stack size (bytes)} sets the maximum size for stack of the task, {Synchronize the data transfer of this task with the caller task} selects synchronization and {Timer resolution (seconds)} sets the resolution for timer. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Task name (10 characters or less)
params.values: Task function name Task0 (default) | character vector

params.name: Stack size (bytes)
params.values: Maximum size for stack of the task 1024 (default) | integer

params.name: Synchronize the data transfer of this task with the caller task
Timer resolution (seconds)
params.values: Resolution for timer of the block 1/60 (default)

params.name: Timer size
params.values: Number of bits to store clock tick 32bits (default) | 16bits | 8bits | auto
